verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items describe testing a Zap with sample/pinned data or inspecting per-step input/output before publishing; docs cover integration building, MCP, embedding, and Canvas but not the test/debug workflow in the visual builder. missing for 10: mention of 'test step' or 'pinned sample data' feature, evidence of step-by-step input/output inspection during Zap creation, any documentation of the testing UI.
